title: No negative/validation-rejection scenario: the executor's error paths are happy-path-only covered
detail: All 11 scenarios are happy paths. A regression that logs an invalid command, or silently drops a rejection instead of surfacing the toast, passes CI. Validation exists at the Command stage but its input-layer plumbing is unpinned.
recommended_fix: Add negative scenarios in parity.odin: a terminal-to-terminal draw and an occupied-tile placement asserting no log entry and last_reject/reject_tick set (the toast state).

title: Pad B never driven: Cancel_Drag (brand-new executor branch, one of the round's review fixes) has zero coverage
detail: Cancel_Drag is new executor code — the pad's only escape from a stuck draw — and a listed review-swarm fix. A broken B (drag stranded, no cancel) would ship untested.
recommended_fix: Add a pad scenario: A begins a draw, B aborts it, then A again — assert no command logged, drag cleared, and no stray release-select.

title: Right-click mouse edge transcriptions unpinned: right-while-placing (W3 quirk) and drag-interrupt never execute in a scenario
detail: Scenario 11 pins only the post-commit right-select. The W3-transcribed right-while-placing path (Cancel + Right_Click, a click-target behavior on the hard-blocker mouse surface) and the drag-interrupt swallow branch never execute.
recommended_fix: Extend right_click: a variant with a right press while placing (assert placement cleared + pipe selected) and one with a right press mid-drag (assert swallow + no re-select).

title: Demolish: node flavor, Delete key, and the same-frame executor gate (X mid-drag suppression) untested at the input layer
detail: The Demolish intent is pinned for the pipe flavor only; demolish_node, the Delete key, and the same-frame gate (a press starting a drag must suppress same-frame X) are transcription-unpinned.
recommended_fix: Add a junction demolish scenario (select router, X -> Cmd_Demolish_Node) and a same-frame press+X case asserting the demolish is suppressed.

title: Toggle_Pause (P/Space/Start) and Retry (R/Enter, pad A at Game_Over) never driven; Game_Over unreachable in the parity fixture
detail: The pause and retry transcriptions (mode flip, Game_Over gate in mouse_map/controller_map) could regress silently: no test drives P/Space/Start, R/Enter, or pad A at Game_Over through the intent layer.
recommended_fix: Add two scenarios: dispatch P then P (assert mode toggles) and dispatch R with ictx.mode = .Game_Over (assert a Retry intent reaches on_retry).

title: Advisory test gate: FAIL
evidence: Local execution of the reviewed tree: `odin build harness` (ODIN_ROOT=raylib-sw shadow) then `./bin/harness input-parity` -> "PASS input-parity   11 scenario(s) green — mouse == touch == controller (ODN-12 / FORGE #6)", exit 0. goldens/input_parity_draw.t1 + draw_wide.t1 carry catalog_hash 8f94df8eb817dddb — identical to the whole existing golden family; check_manifest (harness/manifest.odin:117-129) compares per-tick FNV-1a-64 hashes and fails on any divergence, so the two blessed mouse-baseline pins are live, not re-blessed placeholders (the rebase re-bless tracks the #55 catalog-hash fold: state_hash serializes state.catalog_hash, core/serialize.odin:79). Coverage census of the intent layer (24 grouped behaviors): FULL 8 (Select_Tier, Arm_Placement, Begin_Draw, Drag_Release, Cycle_Class, Pan, cross-device equality, golden pins), PARTIAL 11 (Cancel, Cursor_Move, Place_Release, Select, Demolish, Set_Class, Set_Lane, Cycle_Tier, Node_Select, Confirm, Right_Click), NONE 5 (Retry, Toggle_Pause, Cancel_Drag, validation rejection, mouse chord/ESC+right combos).
detail: P0 100% (critical happy paths, 11/11 green locally); P1 ~80% (rejection paths + mouse edge transcriptions untested); overall ~60-70% of the intent surface (8 FULL / 11 PARTIAL / 5 NONE of 24) — under 80%; several review fixes (Cancel_Drag, right-while-placing) unpinned.
recommended_fix: Add negative scenarios (invalid draw/place -> no command + last_reject), pad-B cancel/abort, pause + Game_Over retry, right-while-placing, and same-frame executor-gate cases in harness/parity.odin; deliberately re-bless goldens after.
